title: Sriram Krishnan on Open Source AI's Biggest Week Yet

reader_summary.headline: Open source AI drives supply chains, creates choice, and challenges frontier models.
reader_summary.overview: Providing valuable open-source AI products encourages the entire supply chain to support that success. New models offer better choices and lower prices, forcing frontier labs to drop token prices. Experts suggest governments should help create fair rules so all developers compete equally without unfair advantages.
